The Bid Award Panel adopted the following: 1. Bid Award Panel grant authority to award the contract in accordance with the Contract Details set out in the report (September 19, 2024) from the Chief Procurement Officer: Solicitation Number: Request for Quotation Document Number 4498437173 Description: For the non-exclusive supply of all labour, equipment, and materials necessary to provide Diving Services for the City of Toronto's Water Division. The term of the Contract is to be for a period of one (1) year from the date of award, with an option in favour of the City to extend the agreement on the same terms and conditions for an additional term of up to four (4) additional separate one (1) year periods at the sole discretion of the City and subject to budget approval.
